sourceSentences: Camille empowers her next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and grant her bonus movement speed for 1 second.
If Precision Protocol is recast after 1.5 seconds of the first attack, then the bonus damage is doubled, and key=% of the attack's total damage will be dealt as true damage.
Camille is able to cast Tactical Sweep, Hookshot, or The Hextech Ultimatum during the windup of Precision Protocol's empowered attack without cancelling it.
Enemies hit by the outer half of the cone take bonus physical damage, capped at 300 against monsters, and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds.
Camille is healed for 100% of this bonus damage post-mitigation against enemy champions in the outer half.
Camille can move during the delay, but the hitbox and Camille's visuals are fixed to the initial target direction.
If the grapple collides with terrain, Camille will dash to the collision point and upon arrival attach to the terrain for 1 second, during which she gains the ability to cast Wall Dive.
Camille will be knocked down by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during the dash.
Hookshot can be cast while rooted but not while grounded.
Wall Dive's range is doubled towards enemy champions within 1400 units.
Casting Flash during Wall Dive's dash will interrupt it but Camille will affect enemies around the new location.
Other abilities besides The Hextech Ultimatum can be cast while grappled or during the dash.
Camille becomes untargetable and leaps with displacement immunity towards the target enemy champion over 0.5 seconds, revealing them for the duration and disrupting their ongoing channels.
The type of shield that will be granted to Camille when she attacks any one enemy champion is shown as an icon beneath their health bar: orange for physical shield and blue for magic shield.
You Q a minion first to gain movement speed and then you use that to close the gap. You W to slow them and hit that outer edge then Q again for your true damage.
The next is EWE. This gives you much more flexibility not committing to abilities one after another. The W timing within this combo can vary a lot depending on your distance from the target.
Next, you have the E flash which is simply used to catch someone just outside of your normal E range.
Camille's R cancels channels on cast, making it invaluable against champions like Katarina and Fiddlesticks.
And finally, Camille can traverse some surprisingly thick walls even without the bonus distance from targeting an enemy champion.
It allows you to dash to a wall and then jump off from it in a direction with increased distance towards enemy champions.
For combos, start with your E into a wall and as you recast it to dash at an enemy, use your W to hit as you land. Auto attack into Q before using your ultimate into another auto
Wait for the fight to start and with your insane mobility, E over wall onto their back line and ult.
if you don't use the reactivation for 1 and 1/2 seconds, it's empowered to deal bonus damage and it becomes true damage.
